component.name: Hue Lighter
component.summary: Turn your Hue lights on at sunset and off at sunrise

description.p: Hue Lighter automates the backlighting of your desktop PC: it turns the configured Philips Hue lights on at sunset and off at sunrise, and turns them off when you log out or shut down.
A tray icon lets you switch the lights manually regardless of the time of day.

screenshot.caption: Tray icon in the system tray - allows to manually control the light state
Settings page to configure lights and location to correctly determine sunset and sunrise times

release.description:
